title: sorbus trilocularis
intro: Sorbus trilocularis, commonly known as the Himalayan rowan, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the Himalayas. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus trilocularis include its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-diarrheal, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Sorbus trilocularis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
